title: Water, glass, ice and lava materials
summary: Animated Compatibility-safe water shader with lake/river/ocean/pool presets, fountain ripple water, clear/tinted/frosted glass, ice, lava rock, molten lava and an animated lava_flow shader.
use_when: Lakes, rivers, sea, pools, fountains, windows and glass panels, ice caves, volcano and lava levels.
how_to_use: Water: a PlaneMesh (subdivide_width/depth about 10 per metre for vertex ripples, works flat too) with material_override = load("res://starter/mat-liquid-glass/water_lake.tres") (also water_ocean, water_pool, water_river). Water is opaque (no refraction); put it 0.2-0.5 m below the shore so banks hide the edges. water_river.tres has shore foam: set shader parameter channel_origin (world XZ of the channel centre line), channel_side (unit vector across the river) and channel_half_width (metres); flow_direction sets the current. Small basins/wells: water_fountain.tres on a flat disc (CylinderMesh height 0.02). Glass: glass_clear / glass_tinted / glass_frosted .tres on thin BoxMesh or QuadMesh panes (alpha transparency, double sided). Ice: ice_triplanar.tres. Lava: lava_flow.tres on a flat PlaneMesh for animated molten pools (world XZ mapping, tile_metres 3); lava_rock_triplanar.tres for glowing cracked rock banks; lava_molten.tres for static molten surfaces. Lava emission glows with the WorldEnvironment glow enabled; add an orange OmniLight3D (range 6, energy 2) over lava pools for light on surroundings.

contents.what: cracked blue-green glacier ice; world-triplanar, one repeat = 1.5 m, no UVs needed
same maps on UV1 (uv1_scale 1 = one repeat per UV unit; set uv1_scale = mesh metres / 1.5 m)
dark cooled lava crust with glowing orange cracks; world-triplanar, one repeat = 2 m, no UVs needed
same maps on UV1 (uv1_scale 1 = one repeat per UV unit; set uv1_scale = mesh metres / 2 m)
bright molten orange lava surface; world-triplanar, one repeat = 3 m, no UVs needed
same maps on UV1 (uv1_scale 1 = one repeat per UV unit; set uv1_scale = mesh metres / 3 m)

opaque animated water; uniforms deep/shallow/foam colours, wave_height, wave_scale, flow_direction, flow_speed, foam_amount, river_banks + channel_*, eddy_point/strength, detail_ripples, sky_tint, fresnel_strength
flowing river with shore foam (channel along world Z through x=0, half width 2.25 m)
deep blue sea with 4x larger swells
still basin water with rings from the object centre
two-layer scrolling molten lava with pulsing emission (world XZ)

scale: metres; world-triplanar materials tile at the stated physical repeat size

provenance: water.gdshader generalised from lantern-hollow layout/water.gdshader (eddy point, colours, waves and fresnel now uniforms); water_ripple from layout/fountain.gdshader; lava_flow.gdshader and glass presets written for this pack; ambientCG CC0 1K-JPG maps for ice and lava (Ice003 identified in template-3d-shooter-arena, canonical copy downloaded).
source: ambientcg.com 1K-JPG archives (URL + sha256 per material in source_detail); shaders from lantern-hollow@66b75b8:game/layout/water.gdshader, fountain.gdshader

verified.notes: tools/shoot.sh rendered demo.tscn in Compatibility and Forward+ with no SCRIPT/Parse/shader errors in either log; Compatibility images inspected; tools/fresh_test.sh imported and rendered cleanly in a fresh cloud project. Water is opaque (no refraction/depth fade); glass is alpha-blended without refraction; lava glow verified with stage glow. Previews/shots use work/u03-materials/project/tools/mat_stage.tscn (preview_stage with AgX tonemap, exposure 0.75, sky ambient 0.6, darker floor) because the shared preview_stage's sky ambient + sky specular washes textured materials out in Compatibility (Forward+ is fine); fresh_test renders with preview_stage look washed for that reason only. v1.1 (2026-10-03, owner rule: building blocks only): demo scene and demo scripts moved out; the remaining pieces are unchanged.
